text:
kai: Heads-up — noticed a support credit rollback on the eu-west4 GPU pool invoice. ~€8.3k credit that was applied in Feb shows as reversed on the March invoice. Anyone seen this?

dev-billing-bot: Billing alert: credit_change detected for project:redwood-core, sku:GPU_SUPPORT_CREDIT, delta: -8300 EUR. See billing diff id: bdiff_20260301_77b

mira: Which invoice ID / link?

kai: Billing console link: https://billing.cloudprov.example/invoices/INV-2026-03-eu-west4 (internal) — lines 45-47 show the reversal.

lucas: Pulling raw export now, give me 2m.

ops-oncall: No infra changes on our side — Dedicated commitments and reservations unchanged. No recent tag or project renames either.

lucas: CSV snippet:```
invoice_id,sku,description,amount,timestamp
INV-2026-02-eu-west4,GPU_SUPPORT_CREDIT,"Support credit for committed GPU capacity",-8300,2026-02-28
INV-2026-03-eu-west4,GPU_SUPPORT_CREDIT_REVERSAL,"Reversal: audit adjustment",8300,2026-03-01
```

mira: Provider emailed a note saying credits were audited and rolled back due to "tagging mismatch between billing account and committed resources". They included a reference id: AUDIT-7752.

ana: (finance) I got the same email. They're requesting proof of commitment — PO + commitment id for the reserved GPUs. I can assemble docs but need the exact resource tags and the committed sku mapping.

lucas: Our GPU pool instances are tagged: `redwood-prod-gpu`, `env:prod`, `team:inference`, and billing project is `redwood-core`. Provider claim: some committed resources were under `redwood-dedicated` project historically. We need to map allocation history.

kai: Filing a provider ticket now: CLOUD-1429 created and cc'ing @ana and @lucas. Please attach any commit/PO docs. If appeal succeeds they will reapply the credit, otherwise we may take an ~€8.3k hit this month.

dev-billing-bot: Provider ticket created: https://support.cloudprov.example/tickets/CLOUD-1429 — status: open, priority: P2.

mira: Lucas — can you query the allocation ledger for Jan-Feb to show the GPU reservation reconciliation? We'll need start/stop times and project IDs.

lucas: On it. Initial diff looks like 90% of the capacity was billed under `redwood-core` but 10% had a historical tag to `redwood-dedicated` from a migration script in Jan 2026. That could be the cause.

ana: I'll prepare an invoice reconciliation pack and send to provider support. If they need an SLA/contract reference, ping legal.

ops-oncall: Short term: if provider denies the appeal, we should decide whether to eat the charge or reallocate credits elsewhere. Also check other regions for similar reversals (us-east1, asia).

lucas: Quick scan: no reversal in us-east1 export. This appears scoped to eu-west4 only.

mira: Adding forecasting note: Finance, please assume the reversal is permanent until we hear back. Update March burn forecast +8.3k EUR.

kai: Thanks all. Action items: Lucas -> allocation history + screenshots; Ana -> reconciliation docs + ticket updates; Mira -> update forecast; Ops -> review migration scripts for stray tags. Keep this thread updated. :eyes:
